title: Correct static tension
description: Essential: The final answer for the static tension force must be 6.4 N.

title: Correct static normal force
description: Essential: The final answer for the static normal force must be 4.8 N.

title: Correct dynamic tension
description: Essential: The final answer for the tension during circular motion must be 10 N.

title: Correct dynamic normal force
description: Essential: The final answer for the normal force during circular motion must be 0 N.

title: Force resolution in equilibrium
description: Important: The solution must correctly resolve forces (weight, tension, normal) along the cone's surface and perpendicular to it for the static case.

title: Circular motion condition
description: Important: For the dynamic case, the solution must apply Newton's second law for circular motion, recognizing the normal force becomes zero.

title: Geometry and radius
description: Important: The solution must correctly identify the radius of the circular path as l sin(37°).

title: Unit consistency
description: Optional: All forces should be expressed with the correct unit (N).

title: Sign or direction error
description: Pitfall: Penalize if force components are resolved with incorrect signs or directions relative to the cone's geometry.

title: Misapplied equilibrium
description: Pitfall: Penalize if the static equilibrium equations are incorrectly applied to the dynamic circular motion case.
